fundamental.rationale: [target] docs/tr808-reference.md 12/14 via drum_verify.SPEC | a figure a document states: outside it the model is WRONG | source of record: model/sound_report.py build_properties() | last changed at 7be1490: 56.0 -> 49.4 because contract revision 6 (DR 0009), issue #14: 49.4 Hz is the bridged-T circuit's computed resonance; 56 Hz was Roland's chart figure and is withdrawn.

measurement.name: fundamental
measurement.method: drum_verify.spectrum (Hann over the first 0.500 s, 262144-point rfft) -> parabolic-interpolated maximum inside 20-2000 Hz
measurement.channel: mono: the drum buses summed through drums_fx.output_fx
measurement.resample_hz: none: rendered and analysed at 48000 Hz
measurement.filter: the maximum is restricted to drum_verify.BAND['BD'] = 20-2000 Hz; the signal itself is not filtered
measurement.normalisation: none: a frequency, unaffected by level

fft.transform: real FFT of a Hann-windowed segment
fft.hop: one transform of one segment, not a spectrogram

fit_quality.model: parabolic interpolation of the three bins around the maximum
fit_quality.uncertainty_basis: half the 0.1831 Hz bin spacing before interpolation improves it
fit_quality.noise_floor_treatment: the maximum is taken inside the band, so the -111.7 dB mean level above it cannot become the peak

selection.interval_basis: from the trimmed onset, capped at 0.5 s so a long tail does not dilute the transform (drum_verify.measure's own rule)

decay tau.rationale: [target] docs/tr808-reference.md 12/14 via drum_verify.SPEC; tau, not T20 -- the chart's column is chart_ms and is different | a figure a document states: outside it the model is WRONG | source of record: model/sound_report.py build_properties() | last changed at 7be1490: 127.0 -> 144.0 because contract revision 6 (DR 0009), issue #14: the BD's f0 is the circuit's 49.4 Hz, not the chart's 56, and tau follows it -- 144 ms is reference 2's own table. The 127 ms it replaced was derived from the withdrawn 56 Hz.

measurement.name: decay tau
measurement.method: drum_verify.trim_onset -> moving RMS, drum_verify.ENV_WIN_MS[voice] ms (several periods of the voice's own fundamental) -> drum_verify.decay_fit, least squares on the log-envelope between -3 and -30 dB of its peak
measurement.channel: mono: the drum buses summed through drums_fx.output_fx
measurement.resample_hz: none: rendered and analysed at 48000 Hz
measurement.filter: none on the envelope path -- the envelope is a moving RMS, drum_verify.ENV_WIN_MS[voice] ms (several periods of the voice's own fundamental) of the full-band signal; drum_verify.BAND is applied to the spectrum rows only
measurement.normalisation: none (absolute full scale); the decay is measured relative to the envelope's own peak, so a gain change cannot move it

fft.window: moving RMS, drum_verify.ENV_WIN_MS[voice] ms (several periods of the voice's own fundamental)
fft.hop: none: the envelope is evaluated at every sample

fit_quality.model: least squares on the log-envelope, dB vs s
fit_quality.uncertainty_basis: 1 sigma on tau, propagated from the least-squares covariance of the log-envelope slope
fit_quality.noise_floor_treatment: the fit stops at the first sample -30.0 dB below the envelope peak; the render's last 50 ms sits at -43.4 dB, so no sample inside the floor enters the fit
